### When God Built a Hero
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-december-3.html
Passage: Genesis 37:11
Points:
- Joseph's life illustrates how God sovereignly works through human choices to accomplish His grand purposes.
- God took an ordinary, spoiled youth with grand visions and molded him into a world-saving leader.
- Joseph displayed steady, enduring faith without wavering during severe setbacks and obscurity.
- Faith acts like a muscle that believers must actively exercise in times of adversity and temptation.
- True world changers rely completely on God’s promises rather than external circumstances.

### The Folly of Favoritism
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/the-folly-of-favoritism.html
Passage: Genesis 37:3-4
Points:
- Jacob’s visible partiality toward Joseph sowed destructive discord and hatred within his household.
- Bestowing the ornate robe marked Joseph as superior, triggering deep-seated resentment among his brothers.
- Preferring one person inevitably harms others, fostering arrogance in the favorite and bitterness in the rest.
- Jacob repeated his own parents' past mistakes instead of learning from his family history with Esau.
- Believers must reject favoritism and honor God by extending equal love and care to everyone.
